title: The Lawyer Who Promised to Recover Scam Money
hook: You lost money once. Then a lawyer offers to get it back—for a fee.
description: FBI IC3 warning, 13 August 2025: fictitious law firms target prior cryptocurrency-scam victims, may know exact prior transfer details, impersonate real lawyers and government partners, and request crypto or gift-card payment. Source: https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2025/PSA250813 . IC3 impersonation guidance: https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2025/PSA250418 . Recreated visuals are illustrations.

scenes.narration: After a scam loss, a 'recovery lawyer' promises to get your money back for a fee.
scenes.heading: SECOND CONTACT
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The FBI says fictitious law firms target cryptocurrency scam victims when hope is highest.
scenes.heading: THE TARGET
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The impostor may use a real lawyer's name, copied letterhead, and your old transfer details.
scenes.heading: THE PROOF
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: Those details feel convincing. They do not prove anyone can recover your money.
scenes.heading: THE TURN
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: They may request crypto or prepaid gift cards, sometimes claiming a government connection.
scenes.heading: THE FEE
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The FBI says no law firm is an officially authorized partner of a US government agency for this purpose.
scenes.heading: THE CLAIM
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: Verify the lawyer through an independently found licensing record and call the firm using its official number. Report suspicious recovery offers at IC3.gov.
scenes.heading: THE RULE
scenes.label: Illustration

notes: FBI IC3 13 August 2025 advisory supports lawyer impersonation, copied letterhead, exact earlier transfer details, payment in crypto or gift cards, and false government partnership claims.
FBI 18 April 2025 advisory also warns of scammers claiming funds were recovered.
This portrays a documented pattern using illustrated characters, not a specific named victim.
